<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
Officers post events in the league's channels. Each post shows the time in your own timezone, the details, and who has signed up so far.

## Answering

Press one of the buttons under the event. Usually they are:

- ✅ **Will Attend**
- 🔶 **Tentative**
- ⛔ **Won't Attend**

Your officers may have renamed them. Alagos confirms your answer to you straight away, and your name appears under it on the post within a few seconds (when many people answer at once, the post is updated once for all of them).

The confirmation is private. After **Will Attend** or **Tentative** it has a **🔔 Notices** button: on, you get a reminder before the event and a message if it moves or is cancelled; press it to turn them off for this event only. Your notifications for every event are set in `/my-profile` (see [**Your profile**](/guides/my-profile/)).

**Changed your mind?** Press a different button: your answer moves. Pressing the button you already chose just tells you that you are signed up.

**Some events take more than one answer.** The post says "Multiple responses allowed". There, each button turns that answer on or off for you, and turning them all off takes you off the event.

## Events with roles

Some events ask for a role, such as Tank, Healer or DPS: press your role's button (or **Sign up** and pick it). Only you see the answer, which says whether you are in, or on that role's **bench** and how far down. You move up by yourself when someone drops out.

From that answer you can pick a **second choice**, used if your role is full and the other has room; choose **which character** is coming, if you have more than one; turn this event's **🔔 Notices** on or off; or **Withdraw**. Pressing **Tentative** or **Won't Attend** gives up your role. When you move up from the bench, Alagos tells you in a DM.

## When you cannot sign up

The bot tells you why, privately:

- the event is **full** (the post shows the limit, for example "3/20");
- signups have **closed** (the post says when they close);
- the event is **restricted** to a role you do not have;
- it has been **cancelled** or has **already started**.

## The other buttons

**✏️ Edit Event**, **📝 Edit Template** and **📋 Attendance** are for officers. Pressing them does nothing for anyone else.

## Before and after

- **Reminders**: the officers may set a reminder, posted shortly before the start. If you said you will attend, you also get it in a DM, unless you have turned that off.
- **Discussion**: each event may have its own thread under the post for questions.
- **When it starts**: signups lock. Officers then record who actually came. Signing up is not the same as attending: only the people an officer confirms get credit.
- **Repeating events**: each week's event is a new post with an empty list, usually posted an hour or so before it starts. Sign up again each time.
- **A role for the event**: some events give everyone signed up a role until the event is over (the post says so), for a voice channel or a ping just for that night. It goes when you withdraw, and comes off by itself afterwards.

## Your name in the lists

If you have claimed your character, lists show your in-game name. Otherwise they show your server nickname. See [**Claiming your character**](/guides/claiming/).
